items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: Kent has recorded as a leader of his own group and has shared the stage with Nicholas Payton, Wynton Marsalis, Kevin Eubanks...

ctx.x: Did your father anticipate and then encourage you to pursue music as a career?

He teases us about that now but I think in his own way, you know, for him to have all of us out here performing and doing our thing, there’s a certain sense of pride in that. What any family, you know like you take Ellis and his kids, you know Branford and Wynton and Jason and Delfayo, are you know, I don’t know, I just think that parents are — they say one thing but behind the scenes they’re still like pushing. They want to see their kids do well. Any parent wants to see their kid do well. And for us I think…
Okay, well there’s something to that.
